text: The major of Foreign Languages and Literatures is based on language learning, centered on literary research, and combines cultural cognition with an interdisciplinary perspective. The curriculum usually covers the following modules:Ii. Language Skills CoursesObjective: To cultivate all-round language skills in listening, speaking, reading, writing and translation, and reach professional-level communication and academic research levels.Basic language courses (Grades 1-2) :Phonetic and pronunciation training (such as the International Phonetic Alphabet for English and the rules of French Recitation);Grammar and sentence pattern reinforcement (systematic learning of tenses, clauses, subjunctive mood, etc.)Primary listening and speaking training (daily conversations, in-depth analysis of news listening)Basic reading and writing (training in narrative and argumentative essay structures).Advanced Language Courses (Grades 3-4) :Academic writing (logical construction of papers, citation norms)Simultaneous interpretation/consecutive interpretation (professional translation techniques, such as conference interpretation and literary translation);Business/Technology language application (industry terms, contract translation)Research on dialects and slangs (such as the differences between American English and British English, the honorific system of Japanese).
